name: Spinner
purpose: Small inline indeterminate loading indicator, 12px, colour inherited from the surrounding text, shown inside a control while a long action runs. A generic loading indicator, kept in the shared library. Also (structure): Busy indicator beside a status text, shown while a screen capture runs.
base: none (shadcn has no Spinner; an animated icon with a spin animation)

values.when: 12px square (0.857rem on the 14px root). The only recorded size; used by the Shot button in the attachments section while a screen capture runs. No second size is added until another use appears.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name, default 'Loading'. Rendered as visually hidden text.

states: not rendered (the consumer renders it only while busy; there is no idle state, so it unmounts when loading ends)
keyboard: None. Not focusable. Respect reduced-motion preferences by slowing or stopping the spin.
platform: Web: no recorded use, because web has no screen capture; the widget stays in the shared library for other loading states. Desktop: the reference use exists only if the Shot button and screen capture stay on desktop; the brief does not settle this. / Desktop only in the reference (screen capture; web has no screen capture). Other web busy states are not in this catalogue.
open: Sources: A and B. (1) Decide whether desktop keeps the Shot button and screen capture. If it does not, Spinner has no recorded use in this family. (2) The Shot button's busy and disabled state belongs to the Button family; this widget only draws the indicator. (3) Look (colour and stroke) is not recorded. / B lists this under notWidgets as a loading indicator from the shared feedback family. Kept here with A's measured source (13px beside the capture text); owner to decide. Size 13 is not measured.
